# Frank AI Researcher

> Frank AI Researcher (hifrank.ai) runs AI-moderated voice interviews with your own customers. You create a study, invite customers you already have, and Frank runs the voice interviews and you read the transcripts. It is voice-first and supports 50+ interview languages. Frank does not recruit participants. Frank also has a remote MCP server, and MCP is included on every plan, including Free.

Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Instinct and Muse (tested), plus other MCP clients that support remote servers with OAuth.

- Website: https://www.hifrank.ai
- MCP server: https://www.hifrank.ai/mcp
- MCP endpoint: https://api.hifrank.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE)
- Official MCP Registry name: ai.hifrank/frank
- Source repo (docs and MCP metadata): https://github.com/nar-vardanyan/frank-mcp

- [AI voice interviews for customer feedback](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/ai-voice-interviews-for-customer-feedback.html): What AI voice interviews are, when they fit, and how to run one
